en: A collage-like postcard page featuring four black‑and‑white portraits and group photographs mounted on a decorative backing with pale green illustrative borders. At the top and bottom are identical group photos titled "Bazar 1903." Each shows a large group of people in folk-style clothing posed indoors, with two small circular inset portraits of women at the upper left and right corners of the group image. Between these, in the center of the card, are two separate studio portraits of women: one younger woman in a striped blouse with a bow at the collar (left) and one older woman with light hair pinned up, wearing a patterned dress (right). Red stamps and printed credits are visible under some images. The overall layout resembles an early 20th‑century commemorative or event postcard.
